annotations.title: Sage Control Dossier: DeFi protocol risk (admin keys, upgradeability, governance)

description: DeFi protocol risk check before you deposit, swap or vote: who can upgrade, pause or redirect user funds (admin keys, multisig/emergency council, timelock, governance attack cost), what admins cannot do, incidents and declared unknowns. Covers Aero (Aerodrome + Velodrome merger), Morpho Blue and Moonwell on Base. Look up by contract address or protocol name. Every claim is sourced and confidence-tagged JSON. PAID: $0.010 per call in USDC on Base via x402, or use a 0.25 USDC transfer pass (pay_tx). See payment_options. By Sage.

address.description: A contract address you are about to use (e.g. Morpho 0xBBBB...FFCb, AERO token, VotingEscrow). Not covered = HTTP 400, not charged

pay_chain.description: Chain of pay_tx (default: inferred; 0x hash = base, base58 signature = solana)

pay_tx.description: Optional, for the plain-transfer option (no x402 needed): hash of a USDC transfer of >= 0.25 USDC to this server's receiving address (get it from the payment_options tool). One transfer unlocks every paid tool for 24h.

protocol.description: Protocol name, e.g. aero, aerodrome, velodrome, morpho, moonwell

slug.description: Dossier id (one of slug / protocol / address is needed)
